cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your umbrella's back in its stand. Remember how I taught you to check your things before work? Handle's clean.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is the canopy wet? It hasn't rained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've moved beyond the handle. I gave it a rinse; let me dry it properly for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Very thorough, at last. Have breakfast while I finish cleaning it. You can inspect the spokes again when it's back where it belongs.

reason: Make A grade B increasingly revealing inspection and offer a later pupil check to control restoration without explaining the umbrella pond exposure.
